findings.summary: Interrupt reescribe barrier executing→pre-effect y habilita retry-execute de irreversible ambiguo
findings.acceptance_criteria: Interrupt sin partial con barrier executing MUST persistir unknown o fail-closed irreversible-ambiguous|reconciliation-required; nunca reescribir a pre-effect Test: interrupt mid-executor + effect_class irreversible → journal ≠ pre-effect; resume no reinvoca executor Solo pre-effect durable (efecto no iniciado) MAY retry-execute

findings.summary: Barreras commitJournal ignoran ok:false y continúan al executor
findings.acceptance_criteria: Si commitJournal.ok !== true MUST abortar fail-closed sin ejecutar el efecto Test con store que retorna ok:false en barrera pre-efecto: 0 invocaciones al executor

findings.summary: Fault matrix y tests authority-store no cubren interrupt mid-ejecución ni CAS mid-op commitJournal
findings.acceptance_criteria: Fixture público interrupt tras executing + resume sin reintento ciego irreversible Unit test: commitJournal mid-op + CAS con expectedRevision de load ok; conflicto de estado → cas-conflict
